title.en: An Act Establishing a Regular District Office of the Land Transportation Office (LTO) in the City of Antipolo, Province of Rizal and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a Regular District Office of the Land Transportation Office (LTO) in the City of Antipolo, Province of Rizal and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập một Văn phòng Khu vực Chính quy Land Transportation Office tại Thành phố Antipolo, Tỉnh Rizal, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งสำนักงานเขตปกติ Land Transportation Office ในเมือง Antipolo จังหวัด Rizal และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang membentuk sebuah Kantor Distrik Reguler Land Transportation Office di Kota Antipolo, Provinsi Rizal, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan sebuah Pejabat Daerah Biasa Land Transportation Office di Bandar Antipolo, Wilayah Rizal, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

text.en: There shall be established a regular district office of the Land Transportation Office (LTO) in the City of Antipolo, Province of Rizal.

The Secretary of Transportation and Communications shall immediately include in the Department's programs the operationalization of the LTO District Office in the City of Antipolo, Province of Rizal the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in two (2) newspapers of general circulation.
